title: ABIDE-II variable distributions
description: Course activity for Chapter 1 EDA: inspect how bin count changes the shape of a distribution, and compare variables with different sample sizes.
instructions: Pick a variable and drag the slider to change the number of histogram bins. Predict what the change will do before you move it: fewer bins hide structure, more bins turn random noise into apparent peaks.
reflectionPrompts: Before moving the slider, predict what information disappears with very few bins and what artefacts appear with very many.
Compare age, an IQ score, and a questionnaire score. Which variable needs the most bins before its shape is readable?
Read the available N and missing N for each variable. Why do the ADOS-G and ADI-R totals have so many fewer observations than age?
